name: space-power-transmitter
title: Space Power Transmitter
author: versuffer
description: Adds Space Power Transmitter that links any planet or space platform - even a moving one - to the common space power grid: bidirectional energy transfer through space over any distance, rationed by demand. Draws a constant upkeep to hold the link (600 MW by default, less at higher quality); the link drops if the local network cannot supply it and restores automatically once it can. Unlocked with Cryogenic science (researchable on Aquilo).
